notes.title: Episodes 4 & 5 "Moving Out" New Content and Fixes
notes.content:
It’s been two weeks since the release of Episodes 4 & 5 “Moving Out” and we wanted to take some time to review the launch and be transparent about what happened, our actions so far, and our plans going forward.

We understand this wasn’t our smoothest release and many of you experienced  bugs and other issues after downloading the double episode, including game crashes and laggy sex scenes. (Both have now been fixed.) 

The reality is that I (Steve) faced some personal health issues during production and we have been playing catchup ever since. We wanted to avoid delaying the announced release dates any further so as not to keep you guys waiting, but unfortunately that led to us not catching important bugs that should have been fixed before the release.

In order to make things right, we’ve been working hard to fix any and all issues since, so here’s a full list of all fixes we’ve made since launch:

[list]
[*] Fixed server infinitely retrying connection causing lag during H-scenes
[*] Added title cards to clearly communicate where Episode 4 ends and Episode 5 begins.
[*] Added Episode 5 to Path Builder.
[*] Various changes to in-game dialogue.
[*] Various optimizations to the phone and to Character classes.
[*] Fixed an issue with the scene gallery where ep5 scenes were not showing.
[*] Fixed scenes not playing when they were supposed to.
[*] Fixed animations not playing when they were supposed to.
[*] Fixed bugged scenes sending players back to the beginning of the episode.
[*] Fixed game looping with Lauren at the karaoke bar.
[*] Fixed issues with the phone (missing contacts, messages, kiwii posts and applications).
[*] Fixed player's name randomly being changed to "Wolf".
[*] Fixed various save compatibility issues.
[/list]

Furthermore, we’re going to be adding additional content to Episodes 4 & 5 “Moving Out”, free of charge for any existing owners. This includes new sex animations, new scenes, Kiwii posts, and phone conversations to make sure we address any content related feedback. 

Going forward, we’re going to reserve additional time for internal testing before a launch which will include a bigger emphasis on your guys’ input pre-release as well. We want to ensure that we’re putting fans in a position to talk about the episode itself and where College Kings 2 can go next, rather than having to talk about the bugs and issues they encountered.

We will continue updating and improving the double episode as necessary, just like we’ve done with our previous episodes. One of our core values as a team is providing long term support to the CK series through working directly with our community, and we take it very seriously.

Once the double episode is in a good place we will move the majority of our efforts to episode 6. We've got some exciting plans for the next episode, so keep your eyes peeled for more updates soon!

Lastly, we wanted to say thank you to our community for your support. Your feedback and reviews on the double episode have been hugely helpful in making sure what we're offering is the best it can be! We're able to give CK the love and attention it deserves thanks to the support of our wonderful community, and so we want to ensure that you all feel listened to, and that CK is moving forward in a direction that works for us and our fans!

If you’ve faced any bugs or issues recently we’d love for you to give the episode another try! We appreciate any thoughts and feedback you have to offer, whether it's in the form of Steam reviews, discord messages or comments on our posts.

- Steve

notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We hope you're as excited for the rework as we are! As we gear up to release the new and improved "The Pool Party" reworked episode next week on [b]September 26th[/b] at [b]3pm EDT/12pm PDT/8pm BST[/b], we wanted to share some of the big changes we've made to the episode.

Firstly, "The Pool Party" now truly lives up to its name. We've meticulously crafted the build-up for the party throughout the episode. From party prep to conversations with the other characters, we ensure that the anticipation is palpable and feels natural.

Player feedback on the episode has been at the foundation of this rework from the beginning. The tone of this episode is now in line with the rest of the series, and speaking of consistency, the personalities of our characters in this episode were a big focus for us and we worked hard to ensure that the characters felt true to themselves and that they act accordingly throughout the events of the episode.

Something we’re very excited for players to check out is the increased control we’ve given to the players over MC's personality. Your choices now carry a lot more weight in the story, shaping the events of the episode in more impactful ways. As a new member of the recently revived Social Planning Committee, your decisions will directly impact both the success of the party, as well as the relationships you’ve built from Episode 1. If you put in the time with the girls you’ll be able to find all the new sex scenes we’ve added into the rework!

We're incredibly proud of what we've achieved with this rework, and none of it would be possible without your continued support and feedback! We can’t wait for you all to check it out!

[h2]Existing Saves[/h2]
If you have saves from Episode 2, you will be prompted to restart the episode from the beginning to enjoy the newly updated content.

While it’s not necessary to play the updated Episode 2 to continue Episode 3 saves, we should note that not doing so will reset your Episode 2 decisions to default settings. This means some of your choices may not align with your previous preferences.

Hey everyone!

Steve here. After a lot of hard work from the team, we're delighted to finally announce that the long-awaited rework of [b]Episode 2 "The Pool Party"[/b] has an official date of [b]September 26th[/b] locked in on Steam. Check out the official trailer on our YouTube!

We want every episode of CK to live up to the expectations of our fans, and Episode 2 originally didn't quite hit the mark of what CK is supposed to be, so we've been working non-stop on reworking the entire episode from the ground up and we're confident that it's now one of our best episodes ever. So...

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
As well as reworking what's already there, we've added in tonnes of new content for players to discover, including (but not limited to) new sex scenes, an expanded free roam, and more frat time with both the Wolves and the Apes! We've worked directly with the fanbase and their feedback to ensure that we've cut content that didn't fit CK, and I personally led the re-writing of the episode.

A lot has changed in episode 2, if you load an existing [b]episode 2 save[/b] now you will be placed at the beginning of the episode with your decisions from episode 1 intact. [h2]Will it cost anything?[/h2]
If you [u]already own[/u] the Pool Party chapter then this rework is completely [b]free[/b]. If you only own chapter 1, purchasing chapter 2 is required in order to access the reworked content.

[h2]Finally…[/h2]

notes.title: Dev Update - Episode 2 Revamp, Episode 4 and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I wanted to give you guys an update on what we're currently working on and all the exciting things to come!

[h3]Episode 2 Revamp[/h3]
There is no way for us to let people properly play one episode without having played all previous episodes. Even though we've added a number of scenes to Episode 2 back in December, we're very aware that it has some fundamental issues that require deeper changes.

With Episode 3 out of the way, we thought it'd be good to revisit Episode 2. We're currently working a revamp that will add new core storylines, remove others (such as the Amber detective storyline) and overhaul all existing scenes. We'll be adding a large amount of new scenes and sex scenes with the goal of Episode 2 feeling completely different, much more in line with the College Kings you know and love, and worthy of replaying. 
This update will come Summer 2023 and will be free to all existing owners of Episode 2. We hope that this will cement the longevity of College Kings, as we have lots more content planned for the future!

[h3]Episode 4 [/h3]
Episode 4 is fully outlined and partly written. We know a lot of you are wishing for longer, meatier episodes. So with Episode 4 we'll be developing the episode in two halves, each of which is aimed to be roughly the size of Episode 3, so Episode 4 will hopefully be about twice the length of Episode 3. 
Once we have both halves completed, we'll be releasing them as one meaty Episode on Steam.

You can expect the full Episode 4 later this year.

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
Episode 3 Steam Achievements have now been added, for all of you completionists out there!

Episode 3 will be getting minor changes and adjustments when the Episode 2 revamp is out to ensure everything lines up.

Lastly, we've been doing a major code clean up for both CK1 and CK2 with the hopes that it should drastically reduce saves issues, especially for save transfers, which will be released soon.

I hope you're as excited as we are for all of these upcoming releases!

- Steve

notes.title: CK2 Episode 3 Development Survey + Important Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

This is Steve, giving you an update on what's happened since the video I made.

First of all, thank you for all of the incredibly kind messages. It's been really heartwarming to feel such support after explaining how many mistakes I personally made.

Currently about 10 scenes, including 6 sex scenes are being written  (most of which already done) and are going into production soon to be released as a free update to the pool party, hopefully to be released the end of November. 

Unlike with episode 1, we have decided against making many changes to the episode itself, as most issues are fundamental and not easily fixed with a few line edits. Instead we'll focus on just adding new scenes which are mostly written and edited by me personally, to hopefully make you guys feel better about your purchase.

This brings us to a bigger change that happened, both of our writers have decided to leave as they felt that their ideas, vision and writing style for CK did not match what fans wanted and CK needed. I wish them all the best for the future as I know they did everything they could to make episode 2 great, but they were just the wrong people for the job.

This means that there's only one person left to write Episode 3, and that's me. In all honesty I hadn't written a scene from scratch since CK1, but I'm getting back into it with the episode 2 free update scenes and I'm actually really enjoying it. 

Even though it's a big challenge, I'm excited to plot and write Episode 3 from scratch by myself with the help of two talented editors. 

Thinking about what to do with Episode 3, I've noticed that there's some gaps in my knowledge of what you guys actually want. For example, what previous choices do you feel haven't had any ramifications in ep2? What haven't we addressed?

notes.title: Dev Update - Working on Save Transfers and addressing negative feedback
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm Undergrad Steve, creator of the game.

I live and breathe College Kings and seeing CK2 get mixed reviews is devastating to both me and the team. The reviews are full of valid criticism, you guys are right, we messed up. 

The biggest criticism is the lack of save transfers. This is a feature that we know is possible, but it's quite difficult to achieve and we didn't anticipate it being so highly requested, big misjudgment on my part. 

We are prioritizing getting save transfers to work and will patch it as soon as possible, however it may take a few weeks. 

Besides that there are bugs in the game and the feeling that some paths where more set in stone. This may have been caused by the pathbuilder start or some weird interactions with reputation, that were unintended. I believe CK2 actually has much more complex relationships, but we do not display those properly so it may feel a lot more simplistic, which is again, a mistake on our end.

I also understand that some players are upset about CK1 being made free completely, even though they paid for it. We had hoped that this would allow easier access to CK2 and give the franchise longevity, it may have done the opposite. 

College Kings 2 was an ambitious new beginning, but we missed the mark. Mistakes were made and my own judgement lead us wrong multiple times. But whatever happens, we will fight to make the game better.

So we're sorting through all of your feedback, all the reviews and we will start improving CK2 Act I bit by bit. Enabling save transfers, fixing bugs, making the storylines more complex, closing plot holes, etc.

We may make mistakes, but please believe that there's nothing we care more about than the playerbase enjoying the game. So we will improve the game until that's the case for the vast majority of people.

For this, it'd be very beneficial if you could take 2 minutes and fill out this quick feedback form:
https://forms.gle/3G7RDJYsuqiYiXK17

With your feedback and enough time, we will make this the Act that you were promised. I'm sorry I made the mistakes I made. I really wish I didn't, but we will fix each and every one of them.

- Steve
